title: Gibson Trapezoid Rosewood Capo, 24K Gold, Exclusive

long_description.body:
This easy-to-position Thalia capo has Gibson and Thalia branding and features a 24K Gold finish with a rosewood insert that is adorned with trapezoid inlay.





Easy to position and move with the fretting hand




Includes 10” and 12” radius standard tension rubber fretpads, a microfiber gig pouch, and a clear jewel case




Made in the USA by Thalia




Covered by Thalia’s limited lifetime warranty
